title: Microstructure evolution as a game
summary: We develop a whole-trajectory relaxation framework for dissipative evolutions with non-convex, state- and history-dependent kinetics. The framework arises naturally from a game-theoretical formulation of energy--dissipation evolution. State--rate consistency is eliminated by causal Volterra reconstruction, reducing the problem to a diagonal equilibrium condition on complete rate trajectories. We establish a direct method based on vanishing-defect approximability, compactness, and complementary semicontinuity.
